observations: White sewing machine with a brown top panel.
Brand 'Fischer Rosemarie' is printed on the top panel in photo 0.
A circular stitch selector dial is visible on the right side.
The machine is shown from the front with the needle and presser foot assembly visible.
A watermark 'JOSHUA OLUWATANA' is visible across the center of the image.
The machine is not powered on; the needle is not engaged.

claims.evidence: The photo shows the machine but does not show the stitch selector dial or the needle bar.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and stitching.

risks.risk: The stitch selector dial may be missing or broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the stitch selector dial while the machine is powered on.

risks.risk: The needle bar may be damaged or the needle may be dull.
risks.proof: A photo of the needle bar with the needle fully inserted.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching a piece of fabric.
Photo of the stitch selector dial while the machine is running.
Photo of the needle bar with the needle fully inserted.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
